releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.description:
## Highlights

- Time management with second-precision task dates, a combined date and time picker, and compact date-only views.
- Quiet, grouped Obsidian reminders for task start, scheduled, and due times, configurable up to 60 minutes in advance.
- A structured local reminder snapshot for Agent automations, so the same plan can be delivered outside Obsidian.
- Task IDs and dependency IDs remain available in source mode while staying hidden in Reading View and Live Preview.

See the Reminders guide for setup and delivery behavior.
releases.name: Tasks Datetime 8.4.0

releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.description:
## Highlights

- Expanded the Task Dashboard into a focused workspace for reviewing task progress, risks, and plans.
- Filter dashboard data by time range, folder, tag, status, priority, task property, and frontmatter values; save and reuse dashboard views.
- Review 7- or 30-day completion trends, daily KPIs, overdue and high-priority work, and dated tasks in day or week plans.
- Drill into matching task lists and apply bulk postponement, importance-and-urgency priority, or status updates.

## Fixes

- Removed duplicate progress-chart tooltips by using one dashboard-managed tooltip instead of overlapping with Obsidian's automatic button tooltip.
- Preserve the time of day when calculating recurring tasks, including month-end and hourly recurrences.

## Documentation

- Added Task Dashboard guidance, an updated changelog, release workflow notes, and open-source acknowledgements.

## Compatibility

- Minimum Obsidian version remains `1.8.7`.

releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.description:
## Highlights

- Expanded the task dashboard with today's completion overview and actionable overdue, due-today, and high-priority task lists. Tasks can be completed or opened directly from the dashboard.
- Improved dashboard completion statistics to use tasks due in the selected period and exclude cancelled tasks.
- Clarified the security and compatibility boundary for JavaScript-based Tasks queries, with better expression and placeholder error handling.
- Improved type detection and performance logging coverage.

## Compatibility

- Minimum Obsidian version remains `1.8.7`.
